messages:
taylor: Hey @leo.dealdesk — LinkHealth wants a non-standard billing plan for the pilot->prod deal. They want 50% upfront, then the remainder split into 3 invoices spaced ~75 days apart (Net 75 on each). POC acceptance must gate the 2nd invoice. ARR = $420,000, 12m commit. Can we get deal desk + finance ok?

leo.dealdesk: Need the exact dollar schedule and confirmation of PO/POC acceptance criteria. Also: any credit concerns? Are they requesting invoice holdbacks?

taylor: PO attached in thread (they'll send via email too). Proposed schedule in SOW:```
- 50% on signature (upfront)
- 25% on POC acceptance (objective tests)
- 25% on Go-live
Payment: Net 75 on the 2nd & 3rd invoices. Upfront is immediate.
Additional ask: they want the upfront deposited into an escrow until prod go-live (customer request).```

anya.finance: Finance: We can handle staggered invoices but escrow adds complexity. We need: DUNS, ACH/ wiring terms, and customer legal entity for KYC. Also run a scenario for cashflow impact.

leo.dealdesk: @anya.finance can you table the cashflow sensitivity? I want to know effective payment timing if POC acceptance slips 30–60 days. Also want recommended commercial concession (discount) for accepting Net 75 + escrow.

sam.se: Technical note: The POC requires a small Dedicated pool (2x A100 equivalent) for stable latency. If they insist on isolation we need to reserve capacity which affects cost baseline — include that in the SOW. Also estimate token usage during POC: ~12M tokens/month.

anya.finance: Quick calc: With ARR 420k -> upfront 210k then remaining 210k split over 3 = 70k each. Net 75 pushes cash receipt ~2.5 months after invoice so effective cash timing moves out ~4–5 months depending on milestone timing. If POC acceptance delays, cash gap widens. Recommend 7% concession if we accept escrow + Net75 OR require a 25% smaller upfront to reduce customer pushback.

leo.dealdesk: Proposed commercial: 5% on committed ARR for accepting Net75 + escrow, plus strict acceptance criteria. We can offer to convert to Net30 for post-prod invoices once they pass a credit check and provide the PO. Need finance confirmation.

morgan.legal: Legal: escrow is fine but we need the escrow agreement drafted and sign-off on acceptance tests. We should add a clause: "If POC acceptance is not achieved within X days due to vendor deliverables, customer retains right to invoice offset." Also need to confirm jurisdiction and dispute process.

ops-bot: Credit check ticket created: CC-2026-0789. Status: monitoring.

anya.finance: With credit check pass + signed escrow agreement, finance can approve provisional acceptance of Net75. Final approval pending VP sign-off on the concession and escrow counterparty.

leo.dealdesk: Summing up:
- Action: @taylor update SOW with explicit acceptance tests + escrow language.
- Action: @taylor gather DUNS and PO.
- Action: @anya.finance model final concession and confirm VP signoff.
- Action: @morgan.legal draft escrow + acceptance clauses.
- Ops: credit check in progress (CC-2026-0789).

 taylor: Will update SOW now and ping here when ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

leo.dealdesk: Marking as provisionally approved from deal desk side. Final sign-off after credit + escrow confirmed. :white_check_mark:
